traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.text: The shark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.

traits.name: Breach
traits.text: ⬺ The shark Swims up to its swim Speed, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 25 feet high, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the shark splashes back down into the water.

traits.name: Savage
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The shark hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn. Effect The creature the shark hit takes 1d12 (1d12) slashing damage.

traits.name: Strafing Chomp
traits.text: ⬻ The shark Swims up to half its swim Speed, makes a jaws Strike, and then Swims up to half its Speed further. The Strike deals half damage.
